intent.problem_statement: Apply the official SELLWERK brand identity to the existing prototype foundation, ensuring visual consistency with sellwerk.de.
success_metrics: Primary color #00AF9C implemented as main accent
Dashboard and Landing Page components reflect 'Professional yet friendly' tone
Responsive layout with generous white space

constraints.performance_requirements: Fast page loads, optimized font loading
limitations: No radical layout changes unless necessary for 'clean' feel

logic_flows: CSS variables -> Tailwind Theme -> React Components

decisions.rationale: Aligns with SELLWERK's professional 'Mittelstand' target audience and avoids visual dissonance between playful naming and premium design.
decisions.impact: Requires renaming 'Digital Janitor' UI elements, swapping techy icons for professional line icons, and using realistic imagery.

decisions.decision: Option A: Google Fonts (Montserrat/Open Sans) + Custom SVG Logo
decisions.rationale: Ensures high-fidelity brand matching and premium aesthetic as per SELLWERK design standards.
decisions.impact: Requires integration of next/font/google, creation of a SELLWERK SVG component, and removal of generic 'Janitor' icons.

decisions.decision: Option A: Force Light Mode + rounded-xl styling
decisions.rationale: Maintains brand consistency with SELLWERK's bright aesthetic and professional-yet-accessible button shapes.
decisions.impact: Requires disabling CSS media queries for dark mode and standardizing border-radius across components.

decisions.decision: Option A: 'Ihr digitaler Erfolg im Mittelstand' headline
decisions.rationale: Direct, confident, and professional alignment with SELLWERK's marketing tone.
decisions.impact: Requires significant copy updates on the Landing Page and SEO meta tags.
